newsitem.title: USA: NYSE weekly program trading averages 12.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: NYSE weekly program trading averages 12.9 pct.

text.p: The New York Stock Exchange said on Thursday that program trading averaged 12.9 percent of its average daily volume of 483.0 million, or 62.1 million shares, during the week of December 2-6.
Buy programs accounted for a daily average of 34.7 million shares, while sell programs accounted for an average of 27.4 million shares.
In all markets, program trading during the week of December 2-6 averaged 93.7 million shares a day.

Of the five member firms reporting the most program activity on the NYSE, Morgan Stanley and First Boston executed most of their program activity for their own accounts. BNP Securities, Salomon Brothers and Susquehana Brokerage Services executed most or all of their program activity for customers.
During that week, 34.2 percent of program volume executed by NYSE member firms related to index arbitrage and another 3.3 percent involved derivative product-related strategies.
Program trading encompasses portfolio trading strategies involving the purchase or sale of a basket of at least 15 stocks with a total value of $1 million or more.
